name: Gym Membership Agreement
description: The membership agreement the member signs at the front desk: the plan, the member's details, the cancellation terms initialled.

plan.label: Membership plan
plan.description: Monthly, no commitment; 12-month commitment; Annual, paid in full; or Student

body.p: The member may use the club's facilities during opening hours under the club rules, as posted at the front desk.
Dues are charged on the plan's schedule to the payment method the member gives at the front desk.

A monthly membership may be cancelled with 30 days' written notice. A 12-month commitment may be cancelled early only on relocation more than 25 miles from any club, or for a medical reason with a doctor's note; otherwise the remaining months are due. Member's initials: [[initials:Member]]
The member uses the facilities at their own risk and should consult a doctor before starting an exercise programme.
